title: 2026-03-14 云计算结构性升级：AI 与安全功能的渐进式融合驱动行业转型
core_insight: AI 与安全功能的持续融合正成为云计算生态的核心驱动，推动企业与政府数字化转型。

dimension_texts.technology: 云厂商持续推出 AI 与安全融合的原生功能，如 AWS S3 新特性、OpenClaw、Security Hub、Google IAP、Azure GPT‑5.4 等，体现渐进式技术升级。 安全层面引入全栈企业安全能力，Cloudflare 推出基于 AI 的 API 漏洞扫描器，进一步提升平台防护。 Twenty years of Amazon S3 and building what’s next Introducing OpenClaw on Amazon Lightsail to run your autonomous private AI agents AWS Security Hub Extended offers full-stack enterprise security with curated partner solutions Simplify your Cloud Run security with Identity Aware Proxy (IAP) Introducing GPT-5.4 in Microsoft Foundry Fixing request smuggling vulnerabilities in Pingora OSS deployments Active defense: introducing a stateful vulnerability scanner for APIs Azure IaaS series Mistral Document AI in Microsoft Foundry
dimension_texts.infrastructure: 今日未见显著的定价调整或新区域发布，现有区域布局保持稳定。 AWS 推出基于第 5 代 AMD EPYC 的 Hpc8a 实例，提升最高 40% 性能；火山引擎发布四款数据产品，丰富算力与存储能力。 Amazon EC2 Hpc8a Instances powered by 5th Gen AMD EPYC processors are now available 火山引擎正式推出四款数据产品
